## Rewrite change

- [ ] Checks and review evidence are attached.
- [ ] Registry and phase claims match the actual tree.
- [ ] No legacy implementation, documentation, or proof text was copied.

## Hard merge gate

Authorization must identify the exact PR and its current exact head SHA.

- [ ] USER ONLY — I explicitly authorize merging PR #________ at current exact head SHA `________________________________________`.

This box must remain unchecked by agents. Green CI, review approval, prior
authorization, or authorization for another head is not merge authority. A
head change invalidates authorization. Auto-merge, merge queue, direct push,
and force push are forbidden.
